description: Proposed robust aggregation: trainable-parameter update clipping, cosine/norm screening against the coordinate-wise median update, sample-weighted aggregation over accepted clients, and separate robust BatchNorm running-statistic aggregation. Parameters frozen from the seed-7 calibration before any evaluation run.

defense.name: proposed_robust_fedavg_v1
defense.update_scope: trainable parameters (conv/linear weights and biases, BatchNorm affine weight and bias)
defense.weighting: prior sample weights renormalised over accepted clients; flagged clients receive weight 0
defense.fallback: coordinate-wise median of clipped updates if no client is accepted

rules.clipping_norm: 95th percentile of honest parameter-update L2 norms over all clients and rounds
rules.norm_ratio_threshold: max(2.0, 1.5 * maximum honest norm ratio to the per-round median client norm)
rules.cosine_threshold: 0.5 * minimum honest cosine to the coordinate-wise median update (0.0 if that minimum is not positive)
rules.bn_variance_floor: 1e-5, equal to BatchNorm1d eps (fixed a priori, not calibrated)

model_selection: unchanged predefined rule: minimum validation loss over rounds 0-20; test evaluated once per run
